final: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '') AS batting_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS distinct_award_winning_managers, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ma2.player_id) FROM manager_award AS ma2 JOIN player AS p2 ON p2.player_id = ma2.player_id) AS share_of_total FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '') ORDER BY batting_hand
